title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三 武帝下
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三 武帝下 Volume 3 Annals 3: Emperor Wu 3

sentences.zh: 永初元年夏六月丁卯，設壇於南郊，即皇帝位，柴燎告天。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer of the first year of Yongchu, on the day dingmao, an altar was set up at the southern suburb; he took the imperial throne and burned firewood to announce to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer of the inaugural year Yongchu, on the day dingmao, an altar was raised at the southern suburb. Liu Yu took the imperial throne and burned firewood to announce his accession to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 策曰：

translations.literal: The mandate text reads:
translations.idiomatic: The accession proclamation read:

sentences.zh: 皇帝臣裕，敢用玄牡，昭告皇天后帝。

translations.literal: The Emperor, your subject Yu, ventures to use a black bull to proclaim clearly to August Heaven and Sovereign Earth.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, your subject Yu, ventures to offer a black bull and proclaim plainly to August Heaven and Sovereign Earth.

sentences.zh: 晉帝以卜世告終，歷數有歸，欽若景運，以命于裕。

translations.literal: The Jin Emperor, because divination showed his dynasty's allotted span had ended and the mandate had found its destination, reverently followed the flourishing fortune and entrusted the mandate to Yu.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin emperor, because divination showed his dynasty's term had ended and the mandate had passed to its rightful holder, reverently followed the age's flourishing fortune and entrusted the mandate to Yu.

sentences.zh: 夫樹君宰世，天下為公，德充帝王，樂推攸集。

translations.literal: To establish a ruler and govern the age—under Heaven all is public; when virtue fills the place of emperor or king, willing abdication gathers of itself.
translations.idiomatic: To set up a ruler and govern the world: the realm belongs to all; when virtue matches that of emperors and kings, the people's willing endorsement gathers of itself.

sentences.zh: 越俶唐、虞，降暨漢、魏，靡不以上哲格文祖，元勳陟帝位，故能大拯黔首，垂訓無窮。

translations.literal: Tracing from Yao and Shun down through Han and Wei, none failed to have a supreme sage align with the culture-founding ancestor and a chief merit-holder ascend the imperial seat, thereby able greatly to rescue the black-headed people and hand down instruction without end.
translations.idiomatic: From Yao and Shun down through Han and Wei, none failed to have a supreme sage align with the founding ancestor of civilization and a chief merit-holder ascend the throne, thereby greatly rescuing the common people and handing down instruction without end.

sentences.zh: 晉自東遷，四維不振，宰輔焉依，為日巳久。

translations.literal: Since the Jin moved east, the four bonds were not secured; reliance on chief ministers had already lasted a long time.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jin moved south, the four pillars of order no longer held firm, and the court had long depended on chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 難棘隆安，禍成元興，遂至帝主遷播，宗祀堙滅。

translations.literal: Distress piled up in the Long'an reign, disaster took shape in the Yuanxing era, until sovereigns were driven to wander and ancestral sacrifices were buried and extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Hardship piled up in the Long'an era, catastrophe took shape under Yuanxing, until emperors were driven from the capital and the ancestral rites were cut off.

sentences.zh: 裕雖地非齊、晉，眾無一旅，仰憤時難，俯悼橫流，投袂一麾，[1]則皇祀克復。

translations.literal: Though Yu's territory was not like Qi or Jin and his forces lacked a full regiment, looking up he was stirred by the age's hardship, looking down he grieved the flood of ruin; with a shake of his sleeve and one command, [1] the imperial sacrifices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Though Yu's domain was no match for Qi or Jin and his forces scarcely amounted to a regiment, he looked up in anger at the age's calamities and down in grief at the flood of ruin; with a shake of his sleeve and one command, [1] the imperial sacrifices were restored.

sentences.zh: 及危而能持，顛而能扶，姦宄具殲，僭偽必滅。

translations.literal: In danger he could hold fast; when overturned he could set upright; treacherous evildoers were entirely exterminated; usurping pretenders were certainly destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In peril he could hold firm; when the order was overturned he could set it right; treacherous evildoers were wiped out, and usurping pretenders were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 誠興廢有期，否終有數。

translations.literal: Truly, revival of what was abolished has its season; the end of obstruction has its count.
translations.idiomatic: Truly, the revival of what had been cast down has its season, and the end of decline has its reckoning.

sentences.zh: 至於大造晉室，撥亂濟民，因藉時來，實尸其重。

translations.literal: As to greatly rebuilding the Jin house, putting down disorder and aiding the people—riding the tide of the times, he truly bore its weight.
translations.idiomatic: As for greatly rebuilding the Jin house, quelling chaos and succoring the people—riding the tide of the times, he truly bore the heaviest burden.

sentences.zh: 加以殊俗慕義，重譯來庭，正朔所暨，咸服聲教。

translations.literal: Moreover, distant peoples admired righteousness; repeated translators came to court; wherever the correct calendar reached, all submitted to transforming instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, distant peoples admired righteousness, envoys came again and again to court, and wherever the imperial calendar reached, all submitted to civilizing rule.

sentences.zh: 至乃三靈垂象，山川告祥，人神協祉，歲月滋著。

translations.literal: Even the three luminous bodies sent down signs, mountains and rivers announced auspice, man and spirits joined in blessing—the months and years daily grew manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Even the three luminaries sent down portents, mountains and rivers announced auspicious signs, and heaven and earth joined in blessing, so that the mandate grew clearer month by month and year by year.

sentences.zh: 是以羣公卿士，億兆夷人，僉曰皇靈降鑒於上，晉朝款誠於下，天命不可以久淹，宸極不可以暫曠。

translations.literal: Therefore dukes, ministers, and officials, the hundred million common folk, all said the August Spirit sent down inspection from above, the Jin court showed sincerity below—the Mandate of Heaven cannot long be delayed, the imperial pinnacle cannot briefly be vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the nobles, ministers, and officials, and the hundred million common people, all said that the August Spirit looked down from above while the Jin court showed sincerity below: the Mandate of Heaven could not long be delayed, and the imperial throne could not remain vacant.

sentences.zh: 遂逼羣議，恭茲大禮。

translations.literal: They thereupon pressed him with collective counsel and respectfully performed this great rite.
translations.idiomatic: They thereupon pressed him with collective counsel and respectfully performed this great ceremony.

sentences.zh: 猥以寡德，託於兆民之上，雖仰畏天威，略是小節，顧深永懷，[2]祗懼若霣。

translations.literal: Humbly with scant virtue, resting on the myriad people above—though in awe of Heaven's majesty this is a small ceremony, yet turning deeply to lasting recollection, [2] reverent fear as though falling.
translations.idiomatic: Humbly, with scant virtue, I rest upon the myriad people above; though in awe of Heaven's majesty this is a small matter, yet turning deeply to lasting recollection, [2] I am reverently fearful as though about to fall.

sentences.zh: 敬簡元辰，升壇受禪，告類上帝，用酬萬國之情。

translations.literal: Respectfully selecting the great day, ascending the altar to receive the abdication, announcing the category to High God, thereby answering all under Heaven's feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully selecting this great day, I ascend the altar to receive the abdication, announce the succession to High God, and thereby answer the feeling of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 克隆天保，永祚于有宋。

translations.literal: May Heaven's blessing be magnified, and everlasting fortune rest on Song.
translations.idiomatic: May Heaven's blessing be magnified and everlasting fortune rest upon Song.

sentences.zh: 惟明靈是饗。

translations.literal: May the luminous spirits be satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: May the luminous spirits accept this offering.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，備法駕幸建康宮，臨太極前殿。

translations.literal: When the rite was concluded, with full imperial equipage he proceeded to Jiankang Palace and attended the front hall of the Grand Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was concluded, with full imperial equipage he went to Jiankang Palace and took his seat in the front hall of the Grand Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫世代迭興，承天統極，雖遭遇異塗，因革殊事，若乃功濟區宇，道振生民，興廢所階，異世一揆。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Generations in succession rise; inheriting Heaven's succession and reaching the pinnacle—though they meet different paths and institutions change with different affairs, if merit saves the realm and the Way stirs the living people, the stages of rise and fall differ in age but share one measure."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Dynasties rise in succession and inherit Heaven's mandate; though they meet different circumstances and institutions change with the times, when merit saves the realm and the Way stirs the living people, the stages of rise and fall differ in age yet follow one measure."

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，屬當艱運，藉否終之期，因士民之力，用獲拯溺，匡世撥亂，安國寧民，業未半古，功參曩烈。

translations.literal: "I, with meager thinness, stand at a hard fortune; relying on the season when obstruction ends, by the strength of scholars and people I obtained rescue from drowning, corrected the age and put down disorder, settled the state and quieted the people; the enterprise is not yet half of antiquity, yet the achievement rivals past glories."
translations.idiomatic: "I, of meager virtue, stand at a harsh turning in fate; relying on the season when decline was ending and on the strength of scholars and people, I rescued the realm from ruin, set the age right, and settled the state and quieted the people. The achievement is not yet half that of antiquity, yet the merit rivals past glories."

sentences.zh: 晉氏以多難仍遘，曆運巳移，欽若前王，憲章令軌，用集大命于朕躬。

translations.literal: "The Jin clan, because many hardships followed in succession, saw its mandate already shift; reverently following former kings, taking their statutes and present norms, the great mandate was gathered upon my person."
translations.idiomatic: "The Jin house, because hardship followed hardship, saw its mandate already shift; reverently following former kings and taking their statutes as the present norm, the great mandate was gathered upon my person."

sentences.zh: 惟德匪嗣，辭不獲申，遂祗順三靈，饗茲景祚，燔柴于南郊，受終于文祖。

translations.literal: "My virtue does not succeed; I could not decline further, and so reverently followed the three spirits and received this bright fortune; burned firewood at the southern suburb and received the end of the mandate from the culture-founding ancestor."
translations.idiomatic: "My virtue does not match the succession; I could not decline further, and so reverently followed the three spirits, received this bright fortune, burned firewood at the southern suburb, and received the mandate's end from the culture-founding ancestor."

sentences.zh: 猥當與能之期，爰集樂推之運，嘉祚肇開，隆慶惟始，思俾休嘉，惠茲兆庶。

translations.literal: "I unworthily stand at the season when the able are gathered, and at the fortune when willing abdication assembles; auspicious fortune newly opens, grand celebration has just begun; I think to spread fine blessing and favor these myriad people."
translations.idiomatic: "I unworthily stand at the season when the able are gathered and at the fortune when willing abdication assembles; auspicious fortune has newly opened and grand celebration has just begun; I wish to spread fine blessing and favor these myriad people."

sentences.zh: 其大赦天下。

translations.literal: "Let there be a great amnesty for all under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: "Let there be a great amnesty throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 改晉元熙二年為永初元年。

translations.literal: "Change the second year of Yuanxi of Jin to the first year of Yongchu."
translations.idiomatic: "Change the second year of Yuanxi of Jin to the first year of Yongchu."

sentences.zh: 賜民爵二級。

translations.literal: "Grant the people two ranks of noble status."
translations.idiomatic: "Grant the people two ranks of noble status."

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人穀五斛。

translations.literal: "For widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves, give five piculs of grain per person."
translations.idiomatic: "For widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves, give five piculs of grain per person."

sentences.zh: 逋租宿債勿復收。

translations.literal: "Overdue rents and old debts are not to be collected again."
translations.idiomatic: "Overdue rents and old debts shall not be collected again."

sentences.zh: 其有犯鄉論清議、贓汙淫盜，一皆蕩滌洗除，與之更始。

translations.literal: "Those who have violated village discourse and pure judgment, or committed corruption, debauchery, or theft—all are to be washed clean and removed, and given a new beginning."
translations.idiomatic: "Those who have violated village standards of conduct, or committed corruption, debauchery, or theft—all are to be cleared and given a fresh start."

sentences.zh: 長徒之身，特皆原遣。

translations.literal: "Persons sentenced to long penal service are especially all pardoned and sent home."
translations.idiomatic: "Persons sentenced to long penal service are all specially pardoned and sent home."

sentences.zh: 亡官失爵，禁錮奪勞，一依舊准。」

translations.literal: "Those who lost office or rank, were forbidden from office, or had labor levies taken—all follow the old standards."
translations.idiomatic: "Those who lost office or rank, were barred from office, or had labor levies taken—all follow the former standards."

sentences.zh: 封晉帝為零陵王，全食一郡。

translations.literal: The Jin Emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Lingling, with the full revenue of one commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Lingling, with the full revenue of one commandery.

sentences.zh: 載天子旍旗，乘五時副車，行晉正朔，郊祀天地禮樂制度，皆用晉典。

translations.literal: He bore the Son of Heaven's banner and flags, rode the five-season secondary chariot, followed the Jin calendar, and in sacrificing to Heaven and Earth, rites and music, and institutions—all used Jin regulations.
translations.idiomatic: He bore the Son of Heaven's banners and flags, rode the five-season secondary chariot, followed the Jin calendar, and in sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, rites, music, and institutions—all followed Jin regulations.

sentences.zh: 上書不為表，答表勿稱詔。

translations.literal: In memorials to the throne he did not use the form "memorial"; in replies to memorials the word "edict" was not used.
translations.idiomatic: In memorials to the throne he did not use the form "memorial"; in replies to memorials the word "edict" was not used.

sentences.zh: 追尊皇考為孝穆皇帝，皇妣為穆皇后，尊王太后為皇太后。

translations.literal: Posthumously honored his late father as Emperor Xiaomu, his late mother as Empress Mu, and honored the Wang Empress Dowager as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored his late father as Emperor Xiaomu, his late mother as Empress Mu, and honored the Wang Empress Dowager as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫微禹之感，歎深後昆，盛德必祀，道隆百世。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The feeling at Wei's slighting of Yu runs deep for later generations; great virtue must receive sacrifice, and the Way is exalted for a hundred generations."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "The regret at slighting Yu runs deep for later generations; great virtue must receive sacrifice, and the Way is honored for a hundred generations."

sentences.zh: 晉氏封爵，咸隨運改，至於德參微管，勳濟蒼生，愛人懷樹，猶或勿翦，雖在異代，義無泯絕。

translations.literal: "Jin enfeoffments all changed with the fortune; yet as to those whose virtue matched the slight Guan Zhong and whose merit aided the black-headed people—loving men cherish trees, and even if cut they may not be felled; though in a different age, righteousness does not permit extinction."
translations.idiomatic: "Jin enfeoffments all changed with the shifting mandate; yet for those whose virtue matched Guan Zhong and whose merit aided the people—loving men cherish trees, and even when cut they may not be felled; though in a different age, righteousness does not permit their rites to be extinguished."

sentences.zh: 降殺之宜，一依前典。

translations.literal: "The propriety of lowering and reducing ranks should wholly follow the former canon."
translations.idiomatic: "The propriety of lowering and reducing ranks should wholly follow the former canon."

sentences.zh: 可降始興公封始興縣公，廬陵公封柴桑縣公，各千戶；

translations.literal: "The Duke of Shixing may be reduced and enfeoffed as Duke of Shixing County, the Duke of Luling as Duke of Chaisang County, each with one thousand households;"
translations.idiomatic: "The Duke of Shixing may be reduced and enfeoffed as Duke of Shixing County, the Duke of Luling as Duke of Chaisang County, each with one thousand households;"

sentences.zh: 始安公封荔浦縣侯，長沙公封醴陵縣侯，康樂公可即封縣侯，各五百戶：以奉晉故丞相王導、太傅謝安、大將軍溫嶠、大司馬陶侃、車騎將軍謝玄之祀。

translations.literal: "the Duke of Shi'an enfeoffed as Marquis of Lipu County, the Duke of Changsha as Marquis of Liling County, the Duke of Kangle immediately enfeoffed as county marquis, each with five hundred households: to maintain the sacrifices to former Jin Chancellor Wang Dao, Grand Tutor Xie An, Grand General Wen Qiao, Grand Marshal Tao Kan, and Cavalry General Xie Xuan."
translations.idiomatic: "the Duke of Shi'an enfeoffed as Marquis of Lipu County, the Duke of Changsha as Marquis of Liling County, the Duke of Kangle immediately enfeoffed as county marquis, each with five hundred households—to maintain the sacrifices to former Jin Chancellor Wang Dao, Grand Tutor Xie An, Grand General Wen Qiao, Grand Marshal Tao Kan, and Cavalry General Xie Xuan."

sentences.zh: 其宣力義熙，豫同艱難者，一仍本秩，無所減降。

translations.literal: "Those who exerted strength in the Yixi era and shared hardship are to keep their original ranks without reduction."
translations.idiomatic: "Those who exerted strength in the Yixi era and shared hardship are to keep their original ranks without reduction."

sentences.zh: 」封晉臨川王司馬寶為西豐縣侯，食邑千戶。

translations.literal: "The Jin Prince of Linchuan, Sima Bao, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xifeng, with a fief of one thousand households."
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Prince of Linchuan, Sima Bao, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xifeng, with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以司空道憐為太尉，封長沙王。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Minister of Works Dao Lin was made Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, the Minister of Works Dao Lin was appointed Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Changsha.

sentences.zh: 追封司徒道規為臨川王。

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed the late Minister of Works Dao Gui as Prince of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: The late Minister of Works Dao Gui was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射徐羨之加鎮軍將軍，右衞將軍謝晦為中領軍，宋國領軍檀道濟為護軍將軍，中領軍劉義欣為青州刺史。

translations.literal: Secretariat Director Xu Xianzhi was additionally made General Who Stabilizes the Army; Right Guards General Xie Hui was made Central Army Commander; Song Domain Commander-in-Chief Tan Daoji was made Protector General; Central Army Commander Liu Yixin was made Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Director Xu Xianzhi was additionally appointed General Who Stabilizes the Army; Right Guards General Xie Hui was made Central Army Commander; Song Domain Commander-in-Chief Tan Daoji was made Protector General; Central Army Commander Liu Yixin was made Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 立南郡公義慶為臨川王。

translations.literal: The Duke of Nan Commandery, Yiqing, was established as Prince of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Nan Commandery, Yiqing, was established as Prince of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「夫銘功紀勞，有國之要典，慎終追舊，在心之所隆。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Inscribing merit and recording labor is an important canon of the state; careful conclusion and pursuing the past is what the heart exalts."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Inscribing merit and recording labor is a vital canon of the state; honoring the dead and remembering the past is what the heart holds sacred."

sentences.zh: 自大業創基，十有七載，世路迍邅，戎車歲動，自東徂西，靡有寧日。

translations.literal: "From the founding of the great enterprise for seventeen years, the world's road was obstructed and war chariots moved every year; from east to west there was no day of peace."
translations.idiomatic: "From the founding of the great enterprise for seventeen years, the world's road was obstructed and war chariots moved every year; from east to west there was scarcely a day of peace."

sentences.zh: 實賴將帥竭心，文武盡効，寧內拓外，迄用有成。

translations.literal: "Truly relying on generals exhausting their hearts and civil and military officials exerting all effort, pacifying within and expanding without, they were used and achieved success."
translations.idiomatic: "Truly relying on generals who gave their all and civil and military officials who exerted every effort, they pacified within and expanded without until success was achieved."

sentences.zh: 威靈遠著，寇逆消蕩，遂當揖讓之禮，猥饗天人之祚。

translations.literal: "Prestige and spirit were displayed afar, bandits and rebels were dissolved and swept away, and so at last came the ceremony of abdication; I unworthily received Heaven and man's fortune."
translations.idiomatic: "Prestige and spirit were displayed afar, bandits and rebels were swept away, and so at last came the ceremony of abdication; I unworthily received Heaven and the people's mandate."

sentences.zh: 念功簡勞，無忘鑒寐，凡厥誠勤，宜同國慶。

translations.literal: "Thinking of merit and selecting labor, do not forget them waking or sleeping; all who were sincere and diligent should share the state's celebration."
translations.idiomatic: "Thinking of merit and honoring labor, do not forget them waking or sleeping; all who were sincere and diligent should share the state's celebration."

sentences.zh: 其酬賞復除之科，以時論舉。

translations.literal: "The categories of reward, compensation, and exemption should be discussed and raised in due time."
translations.idiomatic: "The categories of reward, compensation, and exemption should be discussed and raised in due time."

sentences.zh: 戰亡之身，厚加復贈。

translations.literal: "Those who died in battle should receive generous posthumous compensation."
translations.idiomatic: "Those who died in battle should receive generous posthumous compensation."

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，立桂陽公義真為廬陵王，彭城公義隆為宜都王，第四皇子義康為彭城王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Duke of Guiyang, Yizhen, was established as Prince of Luling; the Duke of Pengcheng, Yilong, as Prince of Yidu; the fourth prince, Yikang, as Prince of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, the Duke of Guiyang, Yizhen, was established as Prince of Luling; the Duke of Pengcheng, Yilong, as Prince of Yidu; the fourth prince, Yikang, as Prince of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔曰：「古之王者，巡狩省方，躬覽民物，搜揚幽隱，拯災卹患，用能風澤遐被，遠至邇安。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, an edict stated: "The kings of antiquity made inspection tours and examined regions, personally viewing the people's things, searching out and raising the hidden, rescuing disaster and relieving suffering, thereby able to have transforming influence extend afar and the distant come and the near be at peace."
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, an edict stated: "The kings of antiquity made inspection tours and examined the regions, personally viewing the people's condition, searching out the hidden, rescuing disaster and relieving suffering, thereby extending transforming influence afar so that the distant came and the near were at peace."

sentences.zh: 朕以寡闇，道謝前哲，因受終之期，託兆庶之上，鑒寐屬慮，思求民瘼。

translations.literal: "I, with shallow darkness, fall short of former sages; because of the season of receiving the end of the mandate, I rest upon the myriad people above; waking and sleeping my thoughts attach, thinking to seek the people's sores."
translations.idiomatic: "I, of shallow understanding, fall short of former sages; because of the season of receiving the mandate's end, I rest upon the myriad people above; waking and sleeping my thoughts attach to seeking the people's afflictions."

sentences.zh: 才弱事艱，若無津濟，夕惕永念，心馳遐域。

translations.literal: "Talent is weak and affairs hard, as though without a ford; evening vigilance and constant thought—my heart races to distant regions."
translations.idiomatic: "My talent is weak and affairs difficult, as though without a ford to cross; with evening vigilance and constant thought, my heart races to distant regions."

sentences.zh: 可遣大使分行四方，旌賢舉善，問所疾苦。

translations.literal: "Grand envoys may be dispatched to travel the four directions, displaying the worthy and raising the good, asking what suffering they have."
translations.idiomatic: "Grand envoys may be dispatched to travel the four directions, displaying the worthy and raising the good, and asking what suffering the people have."

sentences.zh: 其有獄訟虧濫，政刑乖愆，傷化擾治，未允民聽者，皆當具以事聞。

translations.literal: "Where lawsuits are deficient or excessive, government and punishments deviate, harm transformation and disturb governance, and are not acceptable to the people's hearing—all should fully report the matter."
translations.idiomatic: "Where lawsuits are deficient or excessive, government and punishments deviate, harm order and disturb governance, and are not acceptable to the people's hearing—all should fully report the matter."

sentences.zh: 萬事之宜，無失厥中，暢朝廷乃眷之旨，宣下民壅隔之情。

translations.literal: "The ten thousand affairs' propriety should lose nothing of the mean; extend the court's regard and proclaim the people's blocked feeling below."
translations.idiomatic: "In the ten thousand affairs, nothing should miss the mean; extend the court's regard and proclaim the people's blocked feelings below."

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，詔曰：「百官事殷俸薄，祿不代耕。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict stated: "The hundred officials' affairs are numerous and salaries thin; emolument does not replace farming."
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, an edict stated: "The hundred officials' affairs are numerous and salaries thin; emolument does not replace farming."

sentences.zh: 雖國儲未豐，要令公私周濟。

translations.literal: "Though state stores are not yet abundant, it is essential to make public and private provision complete."
translations.idiomatic: "Though state stores are not yet abundant, public and private provision must be made complete."

sentences.zh: 諸供給昔減半者，[3]可悉復舊。

translations.literal: "All supplies formerly reduced by half [3] may all be restored to the old amount."
translations.idiomatic: "All supplies formerly reduced by half [3] may all be restored to the old amount."

sentences.zh: 六軍見祿粗可，不在此例。

translations.literal: "The Six Armies' present salaries are roughly adequate and are not included in this rule."
translations.idiomatic: "The Six Armies' present salaries are roughly adequate and are not included in this rule."

sentences.zh: 其餘官僚，或自本俸素少者，亦疇量增之。」

translations.literal: "For the remaining officials, those whose original salaries were always few should also be increased as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: "For the remaining officials, those whose original salaries were always small should also be increased as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 己卯，改晉泰始曆為永初曆。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the Jin Taishi calendar was changed to the Yongchu calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, the Jin Taishi calendar was changed to the Yongchu calendar.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，復置五校三將官，增殿中將軍員二十人，餘在員外。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Five Guards and Three Generals offices were restored; Palace Army commanders were increased by twenty posts, the rest being supernumerary.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, the Five Guards and Three Generals offices were restored; twenty additional Palace Army commander posts were added, with the rest serving outside the quota.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，後將軍、雍州刺史趙倫之進號安北將軍，征虜將軍、北徐州刺史劉懷慎進號北平將軍，征西大將軍、開府儀同三司楊盛進號車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Rear General and Governor of Yong Province Zhao Lunzhi was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the North; General Who Punishes Barbarians and Governor of North Xu Province Liu Huaishen was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North; General Who Punishes the West, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, Yang Sheng was advanced to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, Rear General and Governor of Yong Province Zhao Lunzhi was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North; General Who Punishes Barbarians and Governor of North Xu Province Liu Huaishen was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North; General Who Punishes the West, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, Yang Sheng was advanced to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鎮西將軍李歆進號征西將軍，[5]平西將軍乞佛熾盤進號安西大將軍，征東將軍高句驪王高璉進號征東大將軍，鎮東將軍百濟王扶餘映進號鎮東大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, General Who Stabilizes the West Li Xin was advanced to General Who Punishes the West, [5] General Who Pacifies the West Qifu Chiban was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the West, General Who Punishes the East King Gao Lian of Goguryeo was advanced to Grand General Who Punishes the East, and General Who Stabilizes the East King Buyeo Yeong of Baekje was advanced to Grand General Who Stabilizes the East.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, General Who Stabilizes the West Li Xin was advanced to General Who Punishes the West, [5] General Who Pacifies the West Qifu Chiban was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the West, General Who Punishes the East King Gao Lian of Goguryeo was advanced to Grand General Who Punishes the East, and General Who Stabilizes the East King Buyeo Yeong of Baekje was advanced to Grand General Who Stabilizes the East.

sentences.zh: 置東宮冗從僕射、旅賁中郎將官。

translations.literal: The posts of Supernumerary Attendant of the Eastern Palace and Majordomo of the Palace Lancers were established.
translations.idiomatic: The posts of Supernumerary Attendant of the Eastern Palace and Majordomo of the Palace Lancers were established.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遷神主於太廟，車駕親奉。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the spirit tablets were moved to the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the imperial carriage personally conveyed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, the spirit tablets were moved to the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the emperor personally conveyed them.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔曰：「往者軍國務殷，事有權制，劫科峻重，施之一時。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict stated: "Formerly, when army and state affairs were pressing, matters had provisional regulations; robbery statutes were severe and heavy, applied for a time."
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, an edict stated: "Formerly, when army and state affairs were pressing, matters had provisional regulations; robbery statutes were severe and heavy, applied for a time."

sentences.zh: 今王道惟新，政和法簡，可一除之，還遵舊條。

translations.literal: "Now the royal way is newly renewed, government is harmonious and laws are simple; all may be abolished at once and the old articles followed again."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the royal way is newly renewed, government is harmonious and laws are simple; all may be abolished at once and the old articles followed again."

sentences.zh: 反叛淫盜三犯補冶士，本謂一事三犯，終無悛革。

translations.literal: "Rebellion, debauchery, and theft—three offenses and one is assigned to smelting labor; this originally meant one matter with three offenses and ultimately no reform."
translations.idiomatic: "Rebellion, debauchery, and theft—three offenses and one is assigned to smelting labor; this originally meant one matter with three offenses and ultimately no reform."

sentences.zh: 主者頃多并數眾事，合而為三，甚違立制之旨，普更申明。」

translations.literal: "The responsible officials recently often combined several matters and counted them as three, greatly violating the intent of establishing the regulation; let this be broadly clarified anew."
translations.idiomatic: "The responsible officials recently often combined several matters and counted them as three, greatly violating the intent of establishing the regulation; let this be broadly clarified anew."

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，西中郎將、荊州刺史宜都王義隆進號鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuwu, the General of the Western Interior, Governor of Jing Province, Prince of Yidu Yilong was advanced to General Who Stabilizes the West.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day wuwu, General of the Western Interior, Governor of Jing Province, Prince of Yidu Yilong was advanced to General Who Stabilizes the West.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，開亡叛赦，限內首出，蠲租布二年。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, an amnesty for fugitives who had fled was opened; those who came forward within the limit had two years of land cloth remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, an amnesty for fugitives who had fled was opened; those who came forward within the limit had two years of land cloth remitted.

sentences.zh: 先有資狀、黃籍猶存者，聽復本注。

translations.literal: Those who previously had household registers and yellow registers still preserved may restore their original registration.
translations.idiomatic: Those who previously had household registers and yellow registers still preserved might restore their original registration.

sentences.zh: 諸舊郡縣以北為名者，悉除；

translations.literal: All old commanderies and counties that used "north" in their names are entirely to remove it;
translations.idiomatic: All old commanderies and counties that used "north" in their names were to remove it;

sentences.zh: 寓立於南者，聽以南為號。

translations.literal: those established in the south as exiles may use "south" in their designation.
translations.idiomatic: those established in the south as exiles might use "south" in their designation.

sentences.zh: 又制有無故自殘傷者補冶士，實由政刑煩苛，民不堪命，可除此條。

translations.literal: Also the regulation that those who mutilated themselves without cause were assigned to smelting labor—in truth because government and punishments were numerous and harsh and the people could not bear the mandate—this article may be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Also the regulation that those who mutilated themselves without cause were assigned to smelting labor—in truth because government and punishments were numerous and harsh and the people could not bear the burden—this article may be abolished.

sentences.zh: 罷青州併兗州。

translations.literal: Qing Province was abolished and merged into Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Province was abolished and merged into Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔曰：「彭、沛、下邳三郡，首事所基，情義繾綣，事由情奬，古今所同。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, an edict stated: "The three commanderies Peng, Pei, and Xiapi were the base of the first enterprise; affection and righteousness were close-knit—the matter proceeds from feeling and reward, the same in ancient and modern times."
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, an edict stated: "The three commanderies Peng, Pei, and Xiapi were the base of the first enterprise; affection and righteousness were close-knit—the matter proceeds from feeling and reward, the same in ancient and modern times."

sentences.zh: 彭城桑梓本鄉，加隆攸在，優復之制，宜同豐、沛。

translations.literal: "Pengcheng is the native district of the mulberry-and-catalpa homeland; where special favor is due, the preferential exemption system should be the same as Feng and Pei."
translations.idiomatic: "Pengcheng is the native district of the homeland; where special favor is due, the preferential exemption system should be the same as Feng and Pei."

sentences.zh: 其沛郡、下邳可復租布三十年。」

translations.literal: "Pei Commandery and Xiapi may have land cloth exempted for thirty years."
translations.idiomatic: "Pei Commandery and Xiapi may have land cloth exempted for thirty years."

sentences.zh: 辛未，追諡妃臧氏為敬皇后。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the late consort Lady Zang was posthumously titled Empress Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, the late consort Lady Zang was posthumously titled Empress Jing.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，立王太子為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Wang heir apparent was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, the Wang heir apparent was established as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔曰：「朕承曆受終，猥饗天命。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict stated: "I inherit the mandate and receive the end, unworthily enjoying Heaven's mandate."
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, an edict stated: "I inherit the mandate and receive the succession, unworthily enjoying Heaven's mandate."

sentences.zh: 荷積善之祚，藉士民之力，七廟備文，率由令範。

translations.literal: "Bearing the fortune of accumulated goodness and relying on scholars and people's strength, the seven temples' texts are complete and all follow the present norm."
translations.idiomatic: "Bearing the fortune of accumulated goodness and relying on scholars and people's strength, the seven temples' texts are complete and all follow the present norm."

sentences.zh: 先后祗嚴，獲遂宣訓，蒸嘗肇建，[6]情敬無違。

translations.literal: "The former and later spirits were reverently honored; instruction was duly proclaimed; seasonal offerings were newly established, [6] affection and respect without violation."
translations.idiomatic: "The former and later spirits were reverently honored; instruction was duly proclaimed; seasonal offerings were newly established, [6] with affection and respect unbroken."

sentences.zh: 加以儲宮備禮，皇基彌固，國慶家禮，爰集旬日，豈予一人，獨荷茲慶。

translations.literal: "Moreover the heir's palace rites are complete and the imperial foundation is firmer; state celebration and family rites gather within ten days—how could I alone bear this celebration?"
translations.idiomatic: "Moreover the heir's palace rites are complete and the imperial foundation is firmer; state celebration and family rites gather within ten days—how could I alone bear this celebration?"

sentences.zh: 其見刑罪無輕重，可悉原赦。

translations.literal: "Those now under punishment, without regard to severity, may all be pardoned."
translations.idiomatic: "Those now under punishment, without regard to severity, may all be pardoned."

sentences.zh: 限百日，以今為始。

translations.literal: "The limit is one hundred days, beginning from today."
translations.idiomatic: "The limit is one hundred days, beginning from today."

sentences.zh: 先因軍事所發奴僮，各還本主；

translations.literal: "Bondservants previously levied for military affairs are each returned to their original masters;"
translations.idiomatic: "Bondservants previously levied for military affairs are each returned to their original masters;"

sentences.zh: 若死亡及勳勞破免，亦依限還直。」

translations.literal: "if they died or merit and labor broke the levy, compensation is also returned according to the limit."
translations.idiomatic: "if they died or merit and labor broke the levy, compensation is also returned according to the limit."

sentences.zh: 閏月壬午朔，詔曰：「晉世帝后及藩王諸陵守衞，宜便置格。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the first day renwu, an edict stated: "Jin-era empresses and imperial princes and the tombs of feudatory kings—their guard and defense should promptly be set in regulations."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the first day renwu, an edict stated: "Jin-era empresses and imperial princes and the tombs of feudatory kings—their guard and defense should promptly be set in regulations."

sentences.zh: 其名賢先哲，見優前代，或立德著節，或寧亂庇民，墳塋未遠，並宜洒掃。

translations.literal: "Those famous worthies and former sages favored in prior ages, or who established virtue and showed integrity, or who quelled disorder and sheltered the people—their tombs are not yet distant and all should be swept and sprinkled."
translations.idiomatic: "Those famous worthies and former sages honored in prior ages, or who established virtue and showed integrity, or who quelled disorder and sheltered the people—their tombs are not yet distant and all should be swept and tended."

sentences.zh: 主者具條以聞。

translations.literal: The responsible officials should fully itemize and report.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials were to itemize the matter fully and report it.

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，特進、左光祿大夫孔季恭加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Senior Adviser and Left Household Grandee Kong Jigong was additionally made Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, Senior Adviser and Left Household Grandee Kong Jigong was additionally appointed Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔曰：「主者處案雖多所諮詳，若眾官命議，宜令明審。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict stated: "Though the responsible officials handling cases consult widely on details, when many officials are ordered to deliberate, it should be made clear and examined."
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, an edict stated: "Though officials handling cases consult widely on details, when many officials are ordered to deliberate, the record should be made clear and explicit."

sentences.zh: 自頃或總稱參詳，於文漫略。

translations.literal: "Recently they sometimes generally called it 'consultation and deliberation,' with the text diffuse and brief."
translations.idiomatic: "Recently they sometimes used only the general phrase 'consultation and deliberation,' leaving the text vague and thin."

sentences.zh: 自今有厝意者，皆當指名其人；

translations.literal: "From now on, where there are proposed measures, all should name the person;"
translations.idiomatic: "From now on, where there are proposed measures, each proposer should be named;"

sentences.zh: 所見不同，依舊繼啟。

translations.literal: "where views differ, follow the old practice of successive memorials."
translations.idiomatic: "where views differ, follow the former practice of successive memorials."

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「諸處冬使，或遣或不，事役宜省，今可悉停。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Winter envoys to various places are sometimes sent and sometimes not; corvée labor should be economized—now all may be stopped."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Winter envoys to various places are sometimes sent and sometimes not; corvée labor should be economized—now all such missions may be stopped."

sentences.zh: [7]唯元正大慶，不在其例。

translations.literal: [7] Only the great celebration of New Year's Day is not included in this rule.
translations.idiomatic: [7] Only the great celebration of New Year's Day was excepted from this rule.

sentences.zh: 郡縣遣冬使詣州及都督府，亦停之。」

translations.literal: Commanderies and counties sending winter envoys to the province and to the area-command headquarters are also stopped."
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and counties sending winter envoys to the province and to the area-command headquarters were also stopped."

sentences.zh: 九月壬子朔，置東宮殿中將軍十人，員外二十人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day renzi, ten Eastern Palace Palace Army commanders were established, with twenty supernumerary posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day renzi, ten Eastern Palace Palace Army commanders were established, with twenty supernumerary posts.

sentences.zh: 壬申，置都官尚書。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Minister of Justice was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, the post of Minister of Justice was established.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，改晉所用王肅祥禫二十六月儀，依鄭玄二十七月而後除。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinmao, the Jin practice using Wang Su's auspicious mourning rite of twenty-six months was changed; following Zheng Xuan's twenty-seven months, removal of mourning followed thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinmao, the Jin practice using Wang Su's auspicious mourning rite of twenty-six months was changed; following Zheng Xuan's twenty-seven months, mourning garments were then put aside.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳朔，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day xinsi, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Extending Worth to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the first day xinsi, the emperor attended at the Hall for Extending Worth to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛酉，車駕祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year, on the day xinyou, the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb and proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the second year, on the day xinyou, the emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb and proclaimed a great amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，斷金銀塗。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, gilding with gold and silver was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, gilding with gold and silver was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 以揚州刺史廬陵王義真為司徒，以尚書僕射、鎮軍將軍徐羨之為尚書令、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, was made Governor of Yang Province; Secretariat Director and General Who Stabilizes the Army Xu Xianzhi was made Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, was made Governor of Yang Province; Secretariat Director and General Who Stabilizes the Army Xu Xianzhi was made Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 丙子，南康揭陽蠻反，郡縣討破之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the Jieyang barbarians of Nankang rebelled; commanderies and counties attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, the Jieyang barbarians of Nankang rebelled; commanderies and counties attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己卯，禁喪事用銅釘。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the use of copper nails in funeral affairs was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, the use of copper nails in funeral affairs was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 罷會稽郡府。

translations.literal: The prefectural headquarters of Kuaiji Commandery was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural headquarters of Kuaiji Commandery was abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，車駕幸延賢堂策試諸州郡秀才、孝廉。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jichou, the imperial carriage went to the Hall for Extending Worth to examine by question the outstanding youths and filial and incorrupt candidates of various provinces and commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day jichou, the emperor went to the Hall for Extending Worth to examine by question the outstanding youths and filial and incorrupt candidates of various provinces and commanderies.

sentences.zh: 揚州秀才顧練、豫州秀才殷朗所對稱旨，並以為著作佐郎。

translations.literal: The outstanding youth of Yang Province, Gu Lian, and the outstanding youth of Yu Province, Yin Lang—their answers were deemed fitting, and both were made Attendants Drafting at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The outstanding youth of Yang Province, Gu Lian, and the outstanding youth of Yu Province, Yin Lang—whose answers were deemed fitting—were both appointed Attendants Drafting at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊申，制中二千石加公田一頃。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, it was ordered that ranked officials at two thousand piculs receive one additional qing of public field.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, it was ordered that ranked officials at two thousand piculs receive one additional qing of public field.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，初限荊州府置將不得過二千人，吏不得過一萬人；

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yichou, it was first ordered that Jing Province's headquarters generals not exceed two thousand men and clerks not exceed ten thousand;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day yichou, it was first ordered that Jing Province's headquarters generals not exceed two thousand men and clerks not exceed ten thousand;

sentences.zh: 州置將不得過五百人，吏不得過五千人。

translations.literal: provincial generals not exceed five hundred men, clerks not exceed five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: provincial generals not exceed five hundred men, and clerks not exceed five thousand.

sentences.zh: 兵士不在此限。

translations.literal: Soldiers were not included in this limit.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers were not included in this limit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯朔，詔曰：「淫祠惑民費財，前典所絕，可並下在所除諸房廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day jimao, an edict stated: "Licentious shrines delude the people and waste wealth—former canons abolish them; all local shrines of various halls may be removed."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day jimao, an edict stated: "Licentious shrines delude the people and waste wealth—former canons abolish them; all such local shrines may be removed."

sentences.zh: 其先賢及以勳德立祠者，不在此例。

translations.literal: Those to former worthies and those established for merit and virtue are not included in this rule."
translations.idiomatic: Shrines to former worthies and those established for merit and virtue were not included in this rule."

sentences.zh: 」戊申，車駕於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the imperial carriage heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, the emperor heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左衞將軍王仲德為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Left Guards General Wang Zhongde was made Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Left Guards General Wang Zhongde was made Governor of Ji Province.

translations.literal: Editorial note eight stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note eight stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，置東宮屯騎、步兵、翊軍三校尉官。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiyou, the three commanders of the Eastern Palace—Cavalry, Foot, and Supporting Army—were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jiyou, the three Eastern Palace commanders—Cavalry, Foot, and Supporting Army—were established.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，車駕又幸華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the imperial carriage again went to Hualin Garden to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, the emperor again went to Hualin Garden to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，詔曰：「杖罰雖有舊科，然職務殷碎，推坐相尋。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, an edict stated: "Bamboo flogging, though there is an old statute, yet duties are numerous and minute and imputed guilt follows in succession."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, an edict stated: "Bamboo flogging, though there is an old statute, yet duties are numerous and minute and imputed guilt follows in succession."

sentences.zh: 若皆有其實，則體所不堪；

translations.literal: "If all were carried out in full, the body could not bear it;"
translations.idiomatic: "If all were carried out in full, the body could not bear it;"

sentences.zh: 文行而巳，又非設罰之意。

translations.literal: "to carry out the text and stop there is again not the intent of establishing punishment."
translations.idiomatic: "to carry out the text and stop there is again not the intent of establishing punishment."

sentences.zh: 可籌量觕為中否之格。

translations.literal: "A rough standard of moderate and excessive may be calculated."
translations.idiomatic: "A rough standard of moderate and excessive may be calculated."

sentences.zh: 」車駕又於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage again heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，制諸署敕吏四品以下，又府署所得輒罰者，聽統府寺行四十杖。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, it was ordered that for edict clerks of various offices of fourth rank and below, and for those whom offices and headquarters could directly punish, the supervising headquarters and directorate might administer forty blows.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, it was ordered that for edict clerks of various offices of fourth rank and below, and for those whom offices and headquarters could directly punish, the supervising headquarters and directorate might administer forty blows.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jisi, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jisi, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，車駕又於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renchen, the imperial carriage again heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day renchen, the emperor again heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，詔曰：「兵制峻重，務在得宜。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingyou, an edict stated: "Military regulations are severe and weighty; the essential is fitness."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingyou, an edict stated: "Military regulations are severe and weighty; the essential is fitness."

sentences.zh: 役身死叛，輒考傍親，流遷彌廣，未見其極。

translations.literal: "When corvée soldiers die or desert, nearby kin are immediately investigated; exile and relocation grow ever wider, and the limit is not seen."
translations.idiomatic: "When corvée soldiers die or desert, nearby kin are immediately investigated; exile and relocation grow ever wider, with no limit in sight."

sentences.zh: 遂令冠帶之倫，淪陷非所。

translations.literal: "Thus the girdled-and-capped class sink into what is not their place."
translations.idiomatic: "Thus the girdled-and-capped class sink into what is not their place."

sentences.zh: 宜革以弘泰，去其密科。

translations.literal: "It is fitting to reform with broad clemency and remove the dense statutes."
translations.idiomatic: "It is fitting to reform with broad clemency and remove the dense statutes."

sentences.zh: 自今犯罪充兵合舉戶從役者，便付營押領。

translations.literal: "From now on, those who commit crimes and are assigned to military service with the whole household following corvée should be delivered to the camp for custody."
translations.idiomatic: "From now on, those who commit crimes and are assigned to military service with the whole household following corvée should be delivered to the camp for custody."

sentences.zh: 其有戶統及讁止一身者，[10]不得復侵濫服親，以相連染。

translations.literal: "Where there is household registration and punishment stops at one person, [10] they must not again encroach and extend to kin by implicated contamination."
translations.idiomatic: "Where there is household registration and punishment stops at one person, [10] they must not again encroach on kin by implicated contamination."

sentences.zh: 」己亥，以涼州胡帥大沮渠蒙遜為鎮軍大將軍、開府儀同三司、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the Di chieftain of Liang Province, Juqu Mengxun, was made Grand General Who Stabilizes the Army, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, the Di chieftain of Liang Province, Juqu Mengxun, was made Grand General Who Stabilizes the Army, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕於延賢堂聽訟，以員外散騎常侍應襲為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the imperial carriage heard lawsuits at the Hall for Extending Worth and made Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant for Drafting Ying Xi Governor of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, the emperor heard lawsuits at the Hall for Extending Worth and made Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant for Drafting Ying Xi Governor of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲辰朔，詔刑罰無輕重，悉皆原降。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the third year, on the first day jiachen, an edict stated that punishments, without regard to severity, were all pardoned and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the third year, on the first day jiachen, an edict stated that punishments, without regard to severity, were all pardoned and reduced.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以前冀州刺史王仲德為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the former Governor of Ji Province Wang Zhongde was made Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, the former Governor of Ji Province Wang Zhongde was made Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以尚書令、揚州刺史徐羨之為司空、錄尚書事，刺史如故。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province Xu Xianzhi was made Minister of Works and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing, with his governorship unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province Xu Xianzhi was made Minister of Works and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing, with his governorship unchanged.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍、江州刺史王弘進號衞將軍、開府儀同三司，太子詹事傅亮為尚書僕射，中領軍謝晦為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Comforts the Army and Governor of Jiang Province Wang Hong was advanced to General of the Guards and Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes; Household Mentor of the Heir Fu Liang was made Secretariat Director; Central Army Commander Xie Hui was made Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Comforts the Army and Governor of Jiang Province Wang Hong was advanced to General of the Guards and Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes; Household Mentor of the Heir Fu Liang was made Secretariat Director; Central Army Commander Xie Hui was made Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以輔國將軍毛德祖為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, General Who Assists the State Mao Dezu was made Governor of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, General Who Assists the State Mao Dezu was made Governor of Si Province.

sentences.zh: [11]乙丑，詔曰：「古之建國，教學為先，弘風訓世，莫尚於此，發蒙啟滯，咸必由之。

translations.literal: [11] On the day yichou, an edict stated: "In establishing a state of antiquity, teaching came first; to spread transforming influence and instruct the age, nothing is more honored than this; to open the benighted and relieve stagnation, all must pass through it."
translations.idiomatic: [11] On the day yichou, an edict stated: "In establishing a state of antiquity, teaching came first; to spread transforming influence and instruct the age, nothing is more honored than this; to open the benighted and relieve stagnation, all must pass through it."

sentences.zh: 故爰自盛王，迄于近代，莫不敦崇學藝，修建庠序。

translations.literal: "Therefore from the flourishing kings down to recent ages, none failed to esteem and honor learning and arts and to build and repair schools."
translations.idiomatic: "Therefore from the flourishing kings down to recent ages, none failed to esteem learning and arts and to build and repair schools."

sentences.zh: 自昔多故，戎馬在郊，旍旗卷舒，日不暇給。

translations.literal: "Formerly many troubles; war horses were in the suburbs; banners rolled and unfurled, and days allowed no rest."
translations.idiomatic: "Formerly there were many troubles; war horses were in the suburbs; banners rolled and unfurled, and days allowed no rest."

sentences.zh: 遂令學校荒廢，講誦蔑聞，軍旅日陳，俎豆藏器，訓誘之風，將墜于地。

translations.literal: "Thus schools were left desolate and lectures and recitation went unheard; armies were arrayed daily while sacrificial vessels were stored away; the wind of instruction and guidance was about to fall to earth."
translations.idiomatic: "Thus schools were left desolate and lectures and recitation went unheard; armies were arrayed daily while sacrificial vessels were stored away; the wind of instruction and guidance was about to fall to earth."

sentences.zh: 後生大懼於牆面，故老竊歎於子衿。

translations.literal: "The young greatly feared facing the wall, and old men privately sighed over the collar-gem."
translations.idiomatic: "The young greatly feared facing the wall in ignorance, and old men privately sighed over the collar-gem."

sentences.zh: 此國風所以永思，小雅所以懷古。

translations.literal: "This is why the nation's wind forever thinks of it, and the Lesser Odes therefore cherish antiquity."
translations.idiomatic: "This is why the nation's manners forever yearn for it, and the Lesser Odes therefore cherish antiquity."

sentences.zh: 今王略遠屆，華域載清，仰風之士，日月以冀。

translations.literal: "Now the royal design extends afar and the flowering realm is cleared; those who look up to transforming influence increase day by day in hope."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the royal design extends afar and the flowering realm is cleared; those who look up to transforming influence increase day by day in hope."

sentences.zh: 便宜博延冑子，陶奬童蒙，選備儒官，弘振國學。

translations.literal: "It is fitting broadly to extend noble sons, cultivate and encourage the young, select and prepare Confucian officials, and grandly revive the state school."
translations.idiomatic: "It is fitting broadly to extend noble sons, cultivate and encourage the young, select and prepare Confucian officials, and grandly revive the state school."

sentences.zh: 主者考詳舊典，以時施行。」

translations.literal: The responsible officials should examine the old canon in detail and implement it in due time."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials were to examine the old canon in detail and implement it in due time."

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，詔曰：「豫州南臨江滸，北接河、洛，民荒境曠，轉輸艱遠，撫莅之宜，各有其便。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingchou, an edict stated: "Yu Province borders the river south and adjoins the Yellow and Luo north; the people are desolate and the borders broad, and transport is hard and far—each has its convenience for comforting rule."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day dingchou, an edict stated: "Yu Province borders the river south and adjoins the Yellow and Luo north; the people are desolate and the borders broad, and transport is hard and far—each has its convenience for comforting rule."

sentences.zh: 淮西諸郡，可立為豫州；

translations.literal: "The various commanderies west of the Huai may be established as Yu Province;"
translations.idiomatic: "The various commanderies west of the Huai may be established as Yu Province;"

sentences.zh: 自淮以東，為南豫州。

translations.literal: "east of the Huai is to be South Yu Province."
translations.idiomatic: "east of the Huai is to be South Yu Province."

sentences.zh: 」以豫州刺史彭城王義康為南豫州刺史，征虜將軍劉粹為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, was made Governor of South Yu Province; General Who Punishes Barbarians Liu Cui was made Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, was made Governor of South Yu Province; General Who Punishes Barbarians Liu Cui was made Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 又分荊州十郡還立湘州，左衞將軍張邵為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: Also ten commanderies of Jing Province were separated to re-establish Xiang Province; Left Guards General Zhang Shao was made Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Also ten commanderies of Jing Province were separated to re-establish Xiang Province; Left Guards General Zhang Shao was made Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: [12]戊寅，以徐州之梁，還屬豫州。

translations.literal: [12] On the day wuyin, Liang of Xu Province was returned to Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: [12] On the day wuyin, Liang of Xu Province was returned to Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 三月，上不豫。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the emperor was unwell.

sentences.zh: 太尉長沙王道憐、司空徐羨之、尚書僕射傅亮、領軍將軍謝晦、護軍將軍檀道濟並入侍醫藥。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Prince of Changsha Dao Lin, Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, Secretariat Director Fu Liang, Commander-in-Chief Xie Hui, and Protector General Tan Daoji all entered to attend medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Prince of Changsha Dao Lin, Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, Secretariat Director Fu Liang, Commander-in-Chief Xie Hui, and Protector General Tan Daoji all entered to attend him with medicine.

sentences.zh: 羣臣請祈禱神祇，上不許，唯使侍中謝方明以疾告廟而巳。

translations.literal: The hundred officials requested prayer and supplication to the spirits; the Emperor did not permit it, only sending Palace Attendant Xie Fangming to report the illness to the ancestral temple and no more.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials requested prayer and supplication to the spirits; the emperor did not permit it, only sending Palace Attendant Xie Fangming to report the illness to the ancestral temple and no more.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以司徒廬陵王義真為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Minister of Works Prince of Luling Yizhen was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of South Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, Minister of Works Prince of Luling Yizhen was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of South Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 上疾瘳。

translations.literal: The Emperor's illness abated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's illness abated.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 時秦雍流戶悉南入梁州。

translations.literal: At that time all wandering households of Qin and Yong entered Liang Province southward.
translations.idiomatic: At that time all wandering households of Qin and Yong entered Liang Province southward.

sentences.zh: 庚申，送紵絹萬匹，[13]荊、雍州運米，委州刺史隨宜賦給。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, ten thousand bolts of ramie silk were sent, [13] and rice transported from Jing and Yong provinces; the governors were entrusted to distribute according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, ten thousand bolts of ramie silk were sent, [13] and rice was transported from Jing and Yong provinces; the governors were entrusted to distribute according to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，亡命刁彌攻京城，得入，太尉留府司馬陸仲元討斬之。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the outlaw Diao Mi attacked the capital walls, entered, and the Grand Marshal's Acting Headquarters Major Lu Zhongyuan attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, the outlaw Diao Mi attacked the capital walls, entered, and the Grand Marshal's Acting Headquarters Major Lu Zhongyuan attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，封仇池公楊盛為武都王，平南將軍楊撫進號安南將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yihai, the Duke of Chouchi, Yang Sheng, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu; General Who Pacifies the South Yang Fu was advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yihai, the Duke of Chouchi, Yang Sheng, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu; General Who Pacifies the South Yang Fu was advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以車騎司馬徐琰為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Grand Marshal's Major Xu Yan was made Governor of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, Grand Marshal's Major Xu Yan was made Governor of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司孔季恭薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Left Household Grandee and Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes Kong Jigong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, Left Household Grandee and Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes Kong Jigong died.

sentences.zh: 五月，上疾甚，召太子誡之曰：「檀道濟雖有幹略，而無遠志，非如兄韶有難御之氣也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Emperor was gravely ill and summoned the Crown Prince to admonish him: "Tan Daoji has capacity and plan, but no far-reaching aim; he is not like your brother Shao, who has a hard-to-control spirit."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the emperor was gravely ill and summoned the Crown Prince to admonish him: "Tan Daoji has capacity and plan, but no far-reaching aim; he is not like your brother Shao, who has a spirit hard to control."

sentences.zh: 徐羨之、傅亮當無異圖。

translations.literal: "Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang should have no divergent designs."
translations.idiomatic: "Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang should have no divergent designs."

sentences.zh: 謝晦數從征伐，頗識機變，若有同異，必此人也。

translations.literal: "Xie Hui has followed campaigns many times and knows well how opportunity shifts; if there is divergence, it will surely be this man."
translations.idiomatic: "Xie Hui has followed campaigns many times and knows well how opportunity shifts; if there is divergence, it will surely be this man."

sentences.zh: 小卻，可以會稽、江州處之。

translations.literal: "When he is a little better, he may be placed at Kuaiji and Jiang Province."
translations.idiomatic: "When he recovers a little, he may be placed at Kuaiji and Jiang Province."

sentences.zh: 」又為手詔曰：「朝廷不須復有別府，宰相帶揚州，可置甲士千人。

translations.literal: He also made a hand edict: "The court need not again have a separate headquarters; the chief minister should hold Yang Province and may have one thousand armored soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: He also made a hand edict: "The court need not again have a separate headquarters; the chief minister should hold Yang Province and may have one thousand armored soldiers."

sentences.zh: 若大臣中任要，宜有爪牙以備不祥人者，可以臺見隊給之。

translations.literal: "If among great ministers one holds a key post and should have claws and teeth to guard against unlucky men, he may be given the Terrace Guard detachment."
translations.idiomatic: "If among great ministers one holds a key post and should have guards to ward against unlucky men, he may be given the Terrace Guard detachment."

sentences.zh: 有征討悉配以臺見軍隊，行還復舊。

translations.literal: "Where there is campaigning, all are to be assigned the Terrace Guard army; when they return, the old arrangement is restored."
translations.idiomatic: "Where there is campaigning, all are to be assigned the Terrace Guard army; when they return, the old arrangement is restored."

sentences.zh: 後世若有幼主，朝事一委宰相，母后不煩臨朝。

translations.literal: "If in later generations there is a young sovereign, court affairs are entirely entrusted to the chief minister; the empress dowager need not attend court."
translations.idiomatic: "If in later generations there is a young sovereign, court affairs are entirely entrusted to the chief minister; the empress dowager need not attend court."

sentences.zh: 仗既不許入臺殿門，要重人可詳給班劍。

translations.literal: "Weapons are not permitted to enter the terrace and palace gates; for important men, court swords may be granted in detail."
translations.idiomatic: "Weapons are not permitted to enter the terrace and palace gates; for important men, court swords may be granted in detail."

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，上崩于西殿，時年六十。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the Emperor died in the Western Hall, aged sixty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, the emperor died in the Western Hall, aged sixty.

translations.literal: Editorial note fourteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note fourteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，葬丹陽建康縣蔣山初寧陵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiyou, he was buried at Chuning Mausoleum on Mount Jiang in Jianye County, Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiyou, he was buried at Chuning Mausoleum on Mount Jiang in Jianye County, Danyang.

sentences.zh: 上清簡寡欲，嚴整有法度，未嘗視珠玉輿馬之飾，後庭無紈綺絲竹之音。

translations.literal: The Emperor was pure and simple, with few desires, strict and orderly with laws and standards; he never looked at ornaments of pearls, jade, chariots, or horses, and the rear palace had no sound of silk damask or bamboo pipes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pure and simple, with few desires, strict and orderly with laws and standards; he never looked at ornaments of pearls, jade, chariots, or horses, and the rear palace had no sound of silk damask or bamboo pipes.

sentences.zh: 寧州嘗獻虎魄枕，光色甚麗。

translations.literal: Ning Province once presented an amber pillow; its light and color were very beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: Ning Province once presented an amber pillow; its light and color were very beautiful.

sentences.zh: 時將北征，以虎魄治金創，上大悅，命擣碎分付諸將。

translations.literal: At the time he was about to campaign north and used amber to treat metal wounds; the Emperor was greatly pleased and ordered it pounded and divided among the generals.
translations.idiomatic: At the time he was about to campaign north and used amber to treat metal wounds; the emperor was greatly pleased and ordered it pounded and divided among the generals.

sentences.zh: 平關中，得姚興從女，有盛寵，以之廢事。

translations.literal: When Guanzhong was pacified, he obtained Yao Xing's niece by marriage; she received great favor and he neglected affairs because of her.
translations.idiomatic: When Guanzhong was pacified, he obtained Yao Xing's niece by marriage; she received great favor and he neglected affairs because of her.

sentences.zh: 謝晦諫，即時遣出。

translations.literal: Xie Hui remonstrated, and he immediately sent her out.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Hui remonstrated, and he immediately sent her out.

sentences.zh: 財帛皆在外府，內無私藏。

translations.literal: Wealth and silks were all in the outer treasury; within there was no private store.
translations.idiomatic: Wealth and silks were all in the outer treasury; within there was no private store.

sentences.zh: 宋臺既建，有司奏東西堂施局脚牀、銀塗釘，上不許；

translations.literal: When the Song terrace was first established, the responsible officials memorialized that the eastern and western halls use cabriole-legged couches and silver-coated nails; the Emperor did not permit it;
translations.idiomatic: When the Song terrace was first established, the responsible officials memorialized that the eastern and western halls use cabriole-legged couches and silver-coated nails; the emperor did not permit it;

sentences.zh: 使用直脚牀，釘用鐵。

translations.literal: straight-legged couches were used, and nails were of iron.
translations.idiomatic: straight-legged couches were used, and nails were of iron.

sentences.zh: 諸主出適，遣送不過二十萬，無錦繡金玉。

translations.literal: When princesses went out in marriage, the send-off did not exceed two hundred thousand, and there were no brocades, embroideries, gold, or jade.
translations.idiomatic: When princesses married out, the send-off did not exceed two hundred thousand cash, and there were no brocades, embroideries, gold, or jade.

sentences.zh: 內外奉禁，莫不節儉。

translations.literal: Within and without, all observed the prohibition; none were not frugal.
translations.idiomatic: Within and without the palace, all observed the prohibition; everyone lived frugally.

sentences.zh: 性尤簡易，常著連齒木屐，好出神虎門逍遙，左右從者不過十餘人。

translations.literal: His nature was especially plain and easy; he often wore wooden clogs with linked teeth, liked to go out the Spirit Tiger Gate for leisurely roaming, and attendants following him did not exceed a dozen or so.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was especially plain and unpretentious; he often wore wooden clogs with linked teeth, liked to stroll out the Spirit Tiger Gate, and those who followed him numbered no more than a dozen or so.

sentences.zh: 時徐羨之住西州，嘗幸羨之，便步出西掖門，羽儀絡驛追隨，巳出西明門矣。

translations.literal: At the time Xu Xianzhi lived in West Province; once when he visited Xianzhi, he simply walked out the Western Side Gate; the guard of honor pursued in continuous relays and had already passed the Western Bright Gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xu Xianzhi lived in West Province; once when he visited Xianzhi, he simply walked out the Western Side Gate on foot; the guard of honor pursued in relays and had already passed the Western Bright Gate before catching up.

sentences.zh: 諸子旦問起居，入閤脫公服，止著裙帽，如家人之禮。

translations.literal: When his sons came in the morning to inquire after his health, entering the inner apartments they removed their official robes and wore only skirts and caps, like the rites of a family.
translations.idiomatic: When his sons came in the morning to inquire after his health, entering the inner apartments they removed their official robes and wore only skirts and caps, observing the manners of an ordinary family.

sentences.zh: 孝武大明中，壞上所居陰室，於其處起玉燭殿，與羣臣觀之。

translations.literal: In the Daming era of Emperor Xiaowu, the dark chamber where the late Emperor had lived was demolished, and on that site the Jade Candle Hall was raised; he viewed it with the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daming era of Emperor Xiaowu, the dark chamber where the late emperor had lived was demolished, and on that site the Jade Candle Hall was raised; he viewed it with his ministers.

sentences.zh: 牀頭有土鄣，壁上挂葛燈籠、麻繩拂。

translations.literal: At the head of the bed there was an earthen barrier; on the wall was hung a kudzu lamp shade and a hemp-rope duster.
translations.idiomatic: At the head of the bed stood an earthen barrier; on the wall hung a kudzu lamp shade and a hemp-rope duster.

sentences.zh: [15]侍中袁顗盛稱上儉素之德。

translations.literal: [15] Palace Attendant Yuan Yi greatly praised the late Emperor's virtue of frugality and plainness.
translations.idiomatic: [15] Palace Attendant Yuan Yi greatly praised the late emperor's virtue of frugality and plainness.

sentences.zh: 孝武不答，獨曰：「田舍公得此，以為過矣。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu did not reply, but only said: "That rustic fellow got this far and thought it excessive."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu did not reply, but only said: "That rustic fellow got this far and thought it excessive."

sentences.zh: 」故能光有天下，克成大業者焉。

translations.literal: Thus he was able to spread his light over all under Heaven and achieve the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he was able to spread his light over all under Heaven and achieve the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：漢氏載祀四百，比祚隆周，雖復四海橫潰，而民繫劉氏，惵惵黔首，未有遷奉之心。

translations.literal: The historian states: The Han house carried sacrifices for four hundred years, its fortune comparable to the flourishing Zhou; though the four seas collapsed in ruin, the people were bound to the Liu clan—the trembling black-headed people had no heart to shift allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: The historian states: The Han house carried sacrifices for four hundred years, its fortune comparable to the flourishing Zhou; though the four seas collapsed in ruin, the people remained bound to the Liu clan—the common people had no heart to shift allegiance.

sentences.zh: 魏武直以兵威服眾，故能坐移天曆，鼎運雖改，而民未忘漢。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Wei directly by military prestige made the masses submit, and so was able to sit and shift the heavenly calendar; though the tripod's fortune changed, the people had not forgotten Han.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Wei directly by military prestige made the masses submit, and so was able to sit and shift the heavenly calendar; though the mandate changed, the people had not forgotten Han.

sentences.zh: 及魏室衰孤，怨非結下。

translations.literal: When the Wei house declined and was isolated, resentment was not tied to the lower ranks.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wei house declined and stood isolated, resentment was not tied to the lower ranks.

sentences.zh: 晉藉宰輔之柄，因皇族之微，世擅重權，用基王業。
