translations.literal: Jin relied on the handle of chief ministers; because the imperial clan was slight, generation after generation monopolized heavy power and thereby founded the royal enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Jin relied on the power of chief ministers; because the imperial clan was weak, generation after generation they monopolized heavy authority and thereby founded the royal enterprise.

sentences.zh: 至於宋祖受命，義越前模。

translations.literal: As for the founding emperor of Song receiving the mandate, the righteousness surpassed former models.
translations.idiomatic: As for the founding emperor of Song receiving the mandate, the righteousness surpassed former models.

sentences.zh: 晉自社廟南遷，祿去王室，朝權國命，遞歸台輔。

translations.literal: Since Jin's altars moved south, emolument departed from the royal house; court power and the state's mandate in succession returned to the terrace ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Since Jin's altars moved south, emolument departed from the royal house; court power and the state's mandate in succession returned to the terrace ministers.

sentences.zh: 君道雖存，主威久謝。

translations.literal: The way of the ruler though existed, the sovereign's prestige had long declined.
translations.idiomatic: The way of the ruler though it existed, the sovereign's prestige had long declined.

sentences.zh: 桓溫雄才葢世，勳高一時，移鼎之業巳成，天人之望將改。

translations.literal: Huan Wen's heroic talent covered the age and his merit was highest for a time; the enterprise of shifting the tripod was already accomplished and Heaven and man's expectation was about to change.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen's heroic talent covered the age and his merit stood highest for a time; the enterprise of shifting the mandate was already accomplished and Heaven and man's expectation was about to change.

sentences.zh: 自斯以後，晉道彌昏，道子開其禍端，元顯成其末釁，桓玄藉運乘時，加以先父之業，因基革命，人無異心。

translations.literal: From then on Jin's way grew ever darker; Daozi opened the source of calamity and Yuanxian completed the final provocation; Huan Xuan rode fortune and seized the season, adding his father's former enterprise, and thereby founded revolution—among the people there was no divergent heart.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Jin's way grew ever darker; Daozi opened the source of calamity and Yuanxian completed the final provocation; Huan Xuan rode fortune and seized the season, adding his father's former enterprise, and thereby founded revolution—among the people there was no divergent heart.

sentences.zh: 高祖地非桓、文，眾無一旅，曾不浹旬，夷凶翦暴，祀晉配天，不失舊物，誅內清外，功格區宇。

translations.literal: Gaozu's territory was not like Duke Huan or Duke Wen's, his forces lacked a full regiment; in less than ten days he extinguished the fierce and cut down the violent, sacrificed to Jin and matched Heaven, did not lose the old emblems, punished within and cleared without—merit reached the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's territory was not like Duke Huan or Duke Wen's, his forces scarcely amounted to a regiment; in less than ten days he extinguished the fierce and cut down the violent, sacrificed to Jin and matched Heaven, did not lose the old emblems, punished within and cleared without—merit reached the realm.

sentences.zh: 至於鍾石變聲，柴天改物，民巳去晉，異於延康之初，功實靜亂，又殊咸熙之末。

translations.literal: As to bells and stones changing their sound and burning firewood to Heaven to change things—the people had already departed from Jin, differing from the beginning of Yanxi; the achievement truly quieted disorder, again unlike the end of Xianxi.
translations.idiomatic: As to bells and stones changing their sound and burning firewood to Heaven to change the regime—the people had already departed from Jin, differing from the beginning of Yanxi; the achievement truly quieted disorder, again unlike the end of Xianxi.

sentences.zh: 所以恭皇高遜，殆均釋負。

translations.literal: Therefore Emperor Gong's lofty abdication was nearly equal to laying down a burden.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Emperor Gong's lofty abdication was nearly equal to laying down a burden.

sentences.zh: 若夫樂推所歸，謳歌所集，魏、晉采其名，高祖收其實矣。

translations.literal: As for where willing abdication returns and songs of praise gather—Wei and Jin harvested the name, but Gaozu gathered the reality.
translations.idiomatic: As for where willing abdication returns and songs of praise gather—Wei and Jin harvested the name, but Gaozu gathered the reality.

sentences.zh: 盛哉！

translations.literal: Magnificent!
translations.idiomatic: Magnificent!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 投袂一麾 「麾」各本作「援」，南史作「起」，據禮志三改。

translations.literal: With a shake of the sleeve and one command: in all editions "command" is written "aid"; the History of the Southern Dynasties has "rise"; changed according to the Treatise on Rites, section three.
translations.idiomatic: With a shake of the sleeve and one command: in all editions "command" is written "aid"; the History of the Southern Dynasties has "rise"; changed according to the Treatise on Rites, section three.

sentences.zh: 顧深永懷 「深」各本並作「探」，據禮志三改。

translations.literal: Turning deeply to lasting recollection: in all editions "deep" is written "probe"; changed according to the Treatise on Rites, section three.
translations.idiomatic: Turning deeply to lasting recollection: in all editions "deep" is written "probe"; changed according to the Treatise on Rites, section three.

sentences.zh: 諸供給昔減半者 「給」各本並作「納」，據元龜五０五改。

translations.literal: All supplies formerly reduced by half: in all editions "supply" is written "tribute"; changed according to the Yuance, section 505.
translations.idiomatic: All supplies formerly reduced by half: in all editions "supply" is written "tribute"; changed according to the Yuance, section 505.

sentences.zh: 諸流徙家並聽還本土 各本並奪「流」字，據南史補。

translations.literal: All wandering households are permitted to return to their native districts: all editions omit the character "wander"; supplemented according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: All wandering households are permitted to return to their native districts: all editions omit the character "wander"; supplemented according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 鎮西將軍李歆進號征西將軍 南史、通鑑作「征西大將軍」。

translations.literal: General Who Stabilizes the West Li Xin advanced in rank to General Who Punishes the West: the History of the Southern Dynasties and Comprehensive Mirror have "Grand General Who Punishes the West."
translations.idiomatic: General Who Stabilizes the West Li Xin advanced in rank to General Who Punishes the West: the History of the Southern Dynasties and Comprehensive Mirror have "Grand General Who Punishes the West."

sentences.zh: 此疑脫「大」字。

translations.literal: Here the character "grand" is suspected to be missing.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character "grand" is suspected to be missing.

sentences.zh: 七廟備文率由令範先后祗嚴獲遂宣訓蒸嘗肇建 各本並脫去「七廟備文」及「獲遂」六字，據元龜二０七補。

translations.literal: The seven temples' texts complete and all follow the present norm; the former and later spirits reverently honored; instruction was duly proclaimed; seasonal offerings newly established: all editions omit the six characters "seven temples' texts complete" and "obtained and thereby"; supplemented according to the Yuance, section 207.
translations.idiomatic: The seven temples' texts complete and all follow the present norm; the former and later spirits reverently honored; instruction was duly proclaimed; seasonal offerings newly established: all editions omit the six characters "seven temples' texts complete" and "obtained and thereby"; supplemented according to the Yuance, section 207.

sentences.zh: 又「蒸嘗」各本並作「七廟」，據元龜二０七改。

translations.literal: Also "seasonal offerings" in all editions is written "seven temples"; changed according to the Yuance, section 207.
translations.idiomatic: Also "seasonal offerings" in all editions is written "seven temples"; changed according to the Yuance, section 207.

sentences.zh: 今可悉停 各本並脫「今」字，據本書禮志一、元龜一九一補。

translations.literal: Now all may be stopped: all editions omit the character "now"; supplemented according to this book's Treatise on Rites, section one, and the Yuance, section 191.
translations.idiomatic: Now all may be stopped: all editions omit the character "now"; supplemented according to this book's Treatise on Rites, section one, and the Yuance, section 191.

sentences.zh: 戊申車駕於華林園聽訟己亥以左衞將軍王仲德為冀州刺史 按是月己卯朔，二十一日己亥，三十日戊申。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the imperial carriage heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden; on the day jihai Left Guards General Wang Zhongde was made Governor of Ji Province: according to the calendar, that month began on the day jimao, the twenty-first day was jihai, and the thirtieth day was wushen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen the imperial carriage heard lawsuits at Hualin Garden; on the day jihai Left Guards General Wang Zhongde was made Governor of Ji Province: according to the calendar, that month began on the day jimao, the twenty-first day was jihai, and the thirtieth day was wushen.

sentences.zh: 戊申不當在己亥前，當有誤。

translations.literal: The day wushen should not precede the day jihai; there must be an error.
translations.idiomatic: The day wushen should not precede the day jihai; there must be an error.

sentences.zh: 其有戶統及讁止一身者 「戶統」，元龜二０九作「科戶絕」。

translations.literal: Where there is household registration and punishment stops at one person: for "household registration," the Yuance, section 209, has "registered household cut off."
translations.idiomatic: Where there is household registration and punishment stops at one person: for "household registration," the Yuance, section 209, has "registered household cut off."

sentences.zh: 乙卯以輔國將軍毛德祖為司州刺史 各本並脫「祖」字。

translations.literal: On the day yimao General Who Assists the State Mao Dezu was made Governor of Si Province: all editions omit the character "zu."
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao General Who Assists the State Mao Dezu was made Governor of Si Province: all editions omit the character "zu."

sentences.zh: 據索虜傳，時有司州刺史毛德祖。

translations.literal: According to the Account of the Northern Barbarians, at the time there was Governor of Si Province Mao Dezu.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Account of the Northern Barbarians, at the time there was Governor of Si Province Mao Dezu.

sentences.zh: 晉書毛寶傳宗人德祖附傳：「尋遷督司雍并三州諸軍事、冠軍將軍、司州刺史。

translations.literal: The Jin History biography of Mao Bao, appended biography of clansman Dezu: "Shortly thereafter he was transferred to Supervisor of military affairs of Si, Yong, and Bing provinces, Champion General, and Governor of Si Province."
translations.idiomatic: The Jin History biography of Mao Bao, appended biography of clansman Dezu: "Shortly thereafter he was transferred to Supervisor of military affairs of Si, Yong, and Bing provinces, Champion General, and Governor of Si Province."

sentences.zh: 」今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplemented accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Now supplemented accordingly.

sentences.zh: 左衞將軍張邵為湘州刺史 「張邵」各本並作「張紀」，據通鑑宋武帝永初三年改。

translations.literal: Left Guards General Zhang Shao made Governor of Xiang Province: in all editions "Zhang Shao" is written "Zhang Ji"; changed according to the Comprehensive Mirror, Song Emperor Wu, first year of Yongchu, year three.
translations.idiomatic: Left Guards General Zhang Shao made Governor of Xiang Province: in all editions "Zhang Shao" is written "Zhang Ji"; changed according to the Comprehensive Mirror, Song Emperor Wu, third year of Yongchu.

sentences.zh: 按張邵傳，宋武帝時，「分荊州立湘州，以邵為刺史。」

translations.literal: According to the biography of Zhang Shao, in the time of Song Emperor Wu, "Jing Province was divided to establish Xiang Province, and Shao was made governor."
translations.idiomatic: According to the biography of Zhang Shao, in the time of Song Emperor Wu, "Jing Province was divided to establish Xiang Province, and Shao was made governor."

sentences.zh: 送紵絹萬匹 「紵」各本並作「綜」，據元龜一九五改。

translations.literal: Sent ten thousand bolts of ramie silk: in all editions "ramie" is written "composite"; changed according to the Yuance, section 195.
translations.idiomatic: Sent ten thousand bolts of ramie silk: in all editions "ramie" is written "composite"; changed according to the Yuance, section 195.

sentences.zh: 壁上挂葛燈籠麻繩拂 各本並脫「挂」字。

translations.literal: On the wall hung kudzu lamp shade and hemp-rope duster: all editions omit the character "hang."
translations.idiomatic: On the wall hung kudzu lamp shade and hemp-rope duster: all editions omit the character "hang."

sentences.zh: 據南史、藝文類聚十三引、御覽一二八及四三一引補。

translations.literal: Supplemented according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, Literary Collections, section thirteen citation, Imperial Readings, sections 128 and 431 citations.
translations.idiomatic: Supplemented according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, Literary Collections, section thirteen citation, Imperial Readings, sections 128 and 431 citations.
